description: The accounts whose RepuTend team you're on, with your role on each (owner or member), the account's status and plan, and the businesses each one tracks: each business by its domain, with the review sites RepuTend tracks it on. A tool about one business takes it as business, its domain, when you reach more than one; a tool about the account (the team, the bill, the approval setting) takes account, its owner's email, when you're on more than one account's team; a tool that takes a case_id acts for that case's business.
name: list_businesses
title: List your businesses
